nodes.name: When Called by Another Workflow
nodes.notes:
Input shape expected from WF2:
{
  conversation_id: UUID,
  lead_phone: '+5215512345678',   // no 'whatsapp:' prefix
  lead_name: 'María García',
  property_id: 'EB-12345',
  property_title: 'Depto. Bosques de las Lomas',
  property_price: '$1,000,883 MXN',
  assigned_agent_id: 'agent_yolanda' | null
}

parameters.query:
-- Create auction row. short_code is a 4-char claim token extracted from the UUID.
-- expires_at is 5 minutes from now; tune as you learn what's realistic.
WITH new_auction AS (
  INSERT INTO auctions (
    conversation_id,
    property_id,
    short_code,
    expires_at
  ) VALUES (
    $1::uuid,
    $2,
    UPPER(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', '') FROM 1 FOR 4)),
    NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  )
  RETURNING auction_id, short_code, expires_at
)
SELECT * FROM new_auction;

nodes.name: Merge Auction + Lead Context
nodes.notes: Combines the freshly-created auction (auction_id, short_code) with the original trigger payload (property_title, lead_name, etc.) so the next node has everything in one item.

parameters.query:
-- Fetch the pool: on-shift AND available, plus the assigned agent (if any),
-- deduplicated. The assigned agent is always included even if off-shift —
-- the client explicitly wants them to get a chance to claim their own lead.
SELECT DISTINCT
  a.agent_id,
  a.name,
  a.whatsapp_number
FROM agents a
WHERE (a.on_shift = true AND a.is_available = true)
   OR a.agent_id = $1;

nodes.name: Fetch Notification Pool
nodes.notes: Each output item = one agent to notify. Downstream Twilio node will run once per item.

nodes.name: Send via Twilio WhatsApp
nodes.notes:
TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM env var should be 'whatsapp:+14155238886' (your Twilio WA sender, incl. the prefix).

continueOnFail = true so that a single agent's message failure (e.g. they've blocked the bot) does NOT abort the whole fan-out.

parameters.query:
-- Log every outbound notification for audit.
INSERT INTO messages (
  conversation_id,
  direction,
  sender_type,
  recipient_phone,
  body,
  twilio_sid,
  metadata
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid,
  'outbound',
  'system',
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  $5::jsonb
);
